data.review_body:
I placed an order on July 4, 2026, which had an original delivery window of July 12–19. The order will not arrive by my birthday on July 25, 2026, and is now not expected until as late as August 1—nearly a month after the original date.
I spent over $100 on this order. When I reached out to customer support regarding the significant, unmanaged shipping delays and the missed delivery guarantees, they refused to escalate the issue to a supervisor and only offered me a standard 15% off coupon (requiring a $29+ spend), which is an insulting resolution for such a service failure.
It is unacceptable to treat customers this way when a time-sensitive order is delayed for this long. I will not be shopping with this company again.
data.review_headline: EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED: Month long delays and poor customer service

data.review_body:
After wasting countless hours contacting both SHEIN and BoxNow, BoxNow finally confirmed that the parcel had already been returned to SHEIN. Only then did SHEIN acknowledge the issue.

What is most disappointing is that I had warned them from the beginning that something was wrong, but they repeatedly dismissed my concerns and kept blaming the carrier instead of investigating.

These items were meant for my son's birthday, and because of their lack of action I was left without them on time. This caused unnecessary stress and frustration that could have been avoided if they had simply listened to their customer.

A company should not be judged by how it performs when everything goes smoothly, but by how it handles problems. In my case, SHEIN failed completely. Instead of taking responsibility, they wasted my time with generic replies and passed the blame to someone else.

I have completely lost confidence in SHEIN's customer service and will seriously reconsider placing any future orders.

Update: SHEIN replied with a generic message stating that a solution had been sent by email. However, this does not address the real issue: my concerns were repeatedly dismissed until BoxNow confirmed that the parcel had already been returned to SHEIN. The refund was never the main issue—the way my case was handled was.
data.review_headline: Lost parcel, endless excuses and terrible customer service
